messages.content: The reproducer fails on the current code. Now the fix: start the day at local midnight rather than UTC midnight.

function.name: code_patch
function.arguments: {"path": "schedule/weekly.go", "old": "\tday := local.Truncate(24 * time.Hour)", "new": "\t// Local midnight, not Truncate: Truncate works on UTC days, which in\n\t// zones away from UTC can be the previous local calendar day.\n\tday := time.Date(local.Year(), local.Month(), local.Day(), 0, 0, 0, 0, local.Location())"}
